title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: accounting skills in Excel and Cowork
summary: Hold: the briefing understates the known cost of the Cowork experience. Microsoft documents usage-based billing for Cowork skill calls, so credit consumption cannot be described as unconfirmed and the cost cannot be rated as indirect time only. The roadmap facts and the plugin blocking path are supported.

claims.claim: Users of Cowork plugins must have Microsoft 365 Copilot licences assigned.

claims.claim: The feature's licensing model is included, without a consumption component.
claims.quote: Cowork uses a usage-based billing model. Activities such as model responses, tool and skill calls, image generation, and browser tasks count toward your organization's consumption.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'mixed'. In licensing.notes retain the documented Microsoft 365 Copilot prerequisite and add: 'Cowork uses usage-based billing in Copilot Credits, including skill calls.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/cowork/cowork-admin-governance and https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/usage-based-billing-overview-copilot-credits.

claims.claim: No licence statement is published for the Excel side.
